column3: Keep the composer's UI SDK elements out of the startup files: Token Input and Trigger Menu load when the composer mounts, while Menu with Command and Combobox load on their trigger's first hover, focus or click (lib/ui-sdk-lazy.ts)
column4: After #81 main's startup JS is about 252 KB, and the lane target is 255 KB or less. The editor loads on mount rather than on interaction, because a click on an editor that hasn't upgraded yet is lost. It uses #82's lib/ui-sdk-lazy.ts, extended with command, combobox and editor families
